name: print-prefs-core
title: Print Preferences Core
description: A small shared component the 'force' print-preference plugins build on. It lets Klipper apply a print preference (bed mesh, timelapse) once a print has already started, which Klipper normally refuses. You usually don't install this directly: it comes along automatically when you install a Force Bed Mesh or Force Timelapse plugin, and stays as long as one of them is installed. Updates Klipper's program files; uninstalling restores the originals. Snapmaker U1 only.
tagline: Shared engine for the print-start 'force' options.
